                    while (true) {

                        if (var$13 <= 0)
                            break;

                        var$7[var$8] = var$12;
                        var$8 = $i;
                        var$13 = $u;
                    }
                    var$9 = $l;
                }

            }

        }
        $classes = jl_Character_classMapping.data;
        $l = 0;
        $u = $classes.length - 1 | 0;
        while ($l <= $u) {
            $i = ($l + $u | 0) / 2 | 0;
            $range = $classes[$i];

                $l = $i + 1 | 0;
            else {

                if ($codePoint >= $u)
                    return $range.$data.data[$codePoint - $u | 0];

            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
